description: I’m Muhammed Hüseyin Badeci, founder of Temren Tech. I’m passionate about UAVs, robotics, space technologies, and autonomous systems, with experience in 3D design and hardware integration. Join our team to build practical projects, compete in technology challenges, and learn together. We’re looking for curious, committed teammates with skills in programming, AI, computer vision, electronics, mechanical design, or project management. A willingness to learn is essential.
